svg.title: From the browser to the database (and back)
svg.desc: Six numbered stops: 1 the browser opens http://localhost:8080; 2 the Kubernetes Service gateway, a LoadBalancer; 3 the nginx gateway applies a per-IP rate limit, checks the token and keeps a 1-second cache; 4 it picks the least busy API copy found through the DNS name of the headless Service api; 5 the API checks the token again, the per-user limit and the permissions, and uses its Redis cache; 6 PostgreSQL. The answer returns along the same path. Below, five lanes show where a request can end early: too many requests from one IP get 429 at stop 3, an invalid token gets 401 at stop 3, the same read by the same role within 1 second is answered at stop 3, a read found in Redis is answered at stop 5, everything else and every write reaches PostgreSQL at stop 6.
